description: Source code for LayerLifecycleManager class managing layer addition, removal, transactions, and mirroring in Android's SurfaceFlinger.

classes.name: LayerLifecycleManager
classes.description: Manages lifecycle of layers including addition, removal, transactions, and mirroring.

classes.name: LayerLifecycleManager::References
classes.description: Represents references to a layer, including debug string output.

methods.name: addLayers
methods.description: Adds new layers to the manager, handling mirroring and parent linking.

methods.name: onHandlesDestroyed
methods.description: Handles destruction of layer handles, removing layers and updating references.

methods.name: applyTransactions
methods.description: Applies a list of transactions to update layer states.

methods.name: commitChanges
methods.description: Commits layer additions, destructions, and resets change states.

methods.name: addLifecycleListener
methods.description: Registers a new lifecycle event listener.

methods.name: removeLifecycleListener
methods.description: Removes a registered lifecycle event listener.

methods.name: getLayerFromId
methods.description: Retrieves a layer by its ID.

methods.name: getLinkedLayersFromId
methods.description: Retrieves linked layers for a given layer ID.

methods.name: linkLayer
methods.description: Links a layer to another, updating references.

methods.name: updateDisplayMirrorLayers
methods.description: Updates mirror layers for display mirroring when root layers change.
